training_frequency: every 2 years after initial completion within 6 months of starting the role
new_hire_deadline_text: Within 6 months of starting their role
required_topics: definition of human trafficking and commercial exploitation of children
guidance on identifying individuals at risk for trafficking
differences between labor and sex trafficking in the lodging/restaurant/truck stop industry
role of employees in reporting and responding to trafficking

risks_or_constraints.constraint: Potential fines up to $1,500 per offense

notes: The law applies to all public-facing roles such as receptionists, housekeeping, customer transportation, etc.
